patch_description: Retains the current demand-aware direct rewards, bilateral route support, and two-node cut costs. Every demand gets at most two preferred routes; a heavy demand gets a third only when its rank is within 7% of the second route. This targets ambiguous routing choices without indiscriminately adding couplings. A modest, size-aware penalty increase aims to improve feasibility while leaving valid-topology energy rankings unchanged. Performance improvements require evaluation.
